{{Quote|If I had figured right, behind the armored wall were the rows of capacitors and the power core that supplied the tower with energy.|Gottu|<ref name="GaHV2">{{WEGCite|story=Gottu and His Vibro-ax|book=Dark Force Rising Sourcebook|stext=Gottu and His Vibroaxe|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
A '''capacitor''' was a device that could be used to provide energy to a weapon such as a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] tower.<ref name="GaHV2" />
